meta.description: Suman starts selling pickle bottles on the bus with Daadi's support. She goes through difficulties but eventually sells the whole lot every day. However, the police catch her selling the product illegally

videos.title: Hisaab Kitaab
videos.overview: Suman wants to establish a business by selling homemade pickles to bring her kids back. She trusts her neighbour Shukla Ji with the sales and marketing of the product but finds out about his dishonesty.

videos.title: Shani Rekha
videos.overview: Suman starts selling pickle bottles on the bus with Daadi's support. She goes through difficulties but eventually sells the whole lot every day. However, the police catch her selling the product illegally.

videos.title: Safed Jhooth
videos.overview: Rishu leaves the house and goes to Suman. Shukla Ji apologises to Suman, and they begin afresh, selling the pickle in the market and eventually door-to-door. Suman realises that Rishu needs to return to Dilip’s house.

videos.title: Sticker
videos.overview: Suman meets Manju, who advises her about branding and packaging the pickle. Later, Suman, Shukla Ji, and Daadi think of a brilliant strategy to sell the pickle bottles. Dilip finds out that a competitor has entered the market.

videos.title: BOGO
videos.overview: Suman and Shukla Ji go to nearby dhabas and restaurants to take orders for their pickle. But, no one's ready to give them the advance money. Shukla Ji convinces Suman and Daadi to take the risk, but things get complicated.

videos.title: Wonder Achaar
videos.overview: An impulsive action gives Suman the success she would have never imagined. Dilip is heartbroken when he learns that his mother helped Suman. Suman arrives at Dilip’s house to take her kids.
